contents.results.json: All 45 tuning and 75 final run records, including seeds, settings, both errors, counts, and timing breakdowns.
contents.results.csv: Flat table of the same per-run measurements.
contents.summary.csv: Medians and quartiles for each method and budget.
contents.selection.json: Validation-only parameter choices and candidate scores.
contents.evaluation_points.npz: Exact float64 validation_x and test_x arrays.
contents.source/: Solver and driver snapshots; history/ contains the original numerical drivers.
contents.provenance/: Original source manifests, indexed by SHA-256.
contents.environment.json: Recorded Python, package, CPU, and platform versions.

metric: max(relative L2 error in u, relative L2 error in ub); each error is normalized by the empirical analytical-solution norm on the same sample.
sample_distribution: N(0, 4); validation and test sets are independent of training.

M_meanings.grid: MC pairs per grid node per Picard iteration
M_meanings.direct: Inner MC pairs per training point per label refresh

boxplot.x: Median elapsed time of the last checkpoint completed within the budget

timing: Solve time includes construction, tracing, sampling, labels, and training. Runtime startup and test evaluation are separate; overruns are recorded and excluded from plotted checkpoints.
reproducibility: The plot is reconstructed from saved numerical results. Fresh time-limited training varies with hardware and load, even with fixed seeds. Model weights were not saved.

final_repetitions.extension: Seeds 2103 and 2104 were added to the original three runs; validation-selected configurations were frozen, with no additional tuning.
